args.text: A popcorn machine in a circle, 8 empty circles above it (slots to fill?), coin counter 0 at top. A hand/finger icon on the machine suggests tap it. Bottom card: a bucket, 25 coins, up arrow - probably an upgrade costing 25, greyed out. Back, sound, restart buttons on top. I expect tapping the machine pops popcorn and fills the circles, earning coins.
Each tap adds a kernel to a slot - 4 of 8 now. No coins yet. I guess filling all 8 pops a batch. Tapping more.

8 kernels = a pop! +10 coins, popcorn pieces scattered on the floor, and the upgrade card started filling with yellow (progress to 25?). Satisfying little payoff. Are the floor popcorns collectible? Trying to tap one.

Tapping the floor popcorn just added a kernel too - seems any tap anywhere counts, and the floor bits just faded. Coins still 10. Let me try holding the finger down on the machine instead of tapping - maybe it fills faster.
Holding = just one kernel, no bonus. So it's tap-tap-tap. The yellow bar in the bucket card looks like progress toward 25 coins (10/25). Tapping 6 more for the next pop.
20 coins, card is 80% yellow - confirmed it's a progress fill to 25. One more batch and I can buy the bucket upgrade. A bit repetitive already, 8 taps per 10 coins.
30 coins - the card turned bright gold, bucket went dark brown and the arrow turned red. Clearly says 'buy me now'. Nice clear signal. Tapping it, expecting a bucket to appear or a bigger payout.

Bought it: 30->5 coins. The machine got bigger with a striped awning and bunting - a stand now. Next upgrade is a cart on wheels for 64. Still 8 slots. Curious whether a batch now pays more than 10. Tapping 8.
5 -> 27: a batch now pays 22 instead of 10! Upgrade more than doubled it, and the pop throws way more popcorn around. That felt good. Does anything happen if I just wait? Checking idle for 5 s.
No idle income - waiting does nothing, but the circle ring came back around the machine as a gentle 'tap here' hint. OK, back to tapping. Two more batches should reach 64 for the cart.
71 coins, the cart card is gold with the red arrow again. Buying the cart - expecting the stand to grow wheels and pay more per pop.
Cart bought (71->7): it's on wheels now, bigger, golden kernels sprinkled around. Next is 163 for a bigger cart. Let me see what one batch pays now - tapping 8.
7 -> 55: one batch now pays 48! Doubling again, and a big popcorn shower. Each upgrade roughly doubles the payout. Need about 3 batches for 163.
